scripts.challenge:deploy: pnpm challenge:verify && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler pages deploy --cwd apps/web --branch main --commit-dirty=false
scripts.challenge:dev: pnpm challenge:build && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler pages dev --cwd apps/web --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 4174 --log-level warn
scripts.challenge:setup: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler pages project create koi-design-webmcp-challenge --production-branch main --cwd apps/web
scripts.check: vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 build && vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 check
scripts.ready: vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 build && vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 check && pnpm test:doctor && vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 test && vp exec playwright test --workers=1
scripts.test: vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 build && pnpm test:doctor && vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 test
scripts.test:e2e: vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 build && vp exec playwright test --workers=1
